prompt: Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 120 words). Collision type: hit while turning left in Katy, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported knee injury. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1118; do not mention it.)
text: Officer's narrative: On arrival at the intersection in Katy, Texas, I observed a two-vehicle collision involving a left turn. Driver 1 was operating a sedan northbound and stated they were turning left at the intersection when the front of their vehicle was struck by a pickup truck traveling straight through from the opposite direction, which is Driver 2. Driver 2 stated they had a green signal and did not see the sedan until impact. Both vehicles sustained front-end damage and were not drivable without towing. A Passenger seated in the rear of Driver 1's vehicle was uninjured. Driver 1 reported pain in the left knee and was evaluated by EMS at the scene before declining transport. Driver 2 reported no injuries. Weather was clear and the roadway was dry. Based on statements and vehicle positions, Driver 1 was turning left and was the vehicle required to yield to oncoming traffic. A citation was issued to Driver 1 for failure to yield the right-of-way.
